payload.author: recovery-worker
evidence: 0x0059A620: mov al,[edx+3] loads map_loc(x_dst,y_dst)->region; 0x0059A62E: lea esi,[esi+0x96fc28]
0x0059A6B5: cmp BYTE PTR [esi],0x0 gates the vendetta bit; 0x0059A6CA: add esi,0x20cc per faction f in 1..7
0x20CC is the PlayersData per-faction stride (2099 dwords, base 0x0096C9E0, faction.h) and the byte-width read matches the region_total_bases[128] element type
payload.hypothesis: 0x0096FC28 is PlayersData[f].region_total_bases[region]: find's vendetta mask loop reads one byte there per faction (esi seeded at 0x0096FC28 + the destination tile's region, advanced 0x20CC per faction), so a faction enters mask_vendetta only when it holds a base in the destination's map region; this is the structural identification behind the C spelling PlayersData[f].region_total_bases[region_dst].
